Julie / VectorHealth team —

We are on a tight 48-hour verification window for the Q2 close. To make sure finance can book the expansion in this quarter, can you confirm the following by EOD Monday PT?

- Final SOW sign-off (we've attached VH-SOW-v3.pdf)
- PO or procurement timeline (if PO needed, ETA and contact)
- Any redlines that require legal review

Internal owners: please update stage to "Commit - Legal/PO" or "Commit - Signed" as appropriate in the deal record linked below and ensure the final numbers land in the rollup spreadsheet. I pasted the minimum ask for the rollup:

- ARR: $1,200,000
- Start date: 2027-06-01
- Billing term: annual

Attachments: VH-SOW-v3.pdf
Related: https://redwood.app/sales/deals/VH-2027-Q2-EXPA

As always, the goal here is to make this finance-ready so we can honor the quarter. Quick replies welcome — I will compile and send a final rollup at 10:00 AM PT Monday.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
